description:
Product Adoption Manager

Position Summary:

The Product Adoption Manager, as part of the Product Management family, will ensure that customers understand and can successfully use TazWorks products through the entire product lifecycle. This role will: a) increase adoption of the platform and key partner products, and b) increase satisfaction of CRAs using TazWorks platform and Trade House Data products provided via the platform. The role will identify opportunities for product enhancements and partner with the Product team to prioritize.

Expected Duties:

· Establish success criteria for new-logo Consumer Reporting Agencies (CRAs), the background screening customers that use TazWorks

· Work with the new logo CRAs for a year after the implementation to ensure adherence to the established criteria

· In partnership with Customer Success, the Product Adoption Manager will proactively work with the target customers to increase TazWorks' and key partners' product adoption and usage

· Responsible for creating programs to educate customers on TazWorks and partner capabilities. This program will include email campaigns, webinars, as well as other means deemed impactful

· The role will demonstrate to existing customers the value of specific functional aspects of TazWorks – how usage creates value for our CRAs and their customers

· Expected to analyze product adoption and usage data to pinpoint areas requiring focus while utilizing internal tools to track all customer activities

Required Qualifications:

Product Adoption Manager will have a full understanding of the areas of responsibility for the role and perform all aspects of the role independently. The role may have work that includes new, highly complex, or highly impactful products to the business.

· Career-level professional with at least 4 years of experience in Background Screening

· Considered highly skilled and proficient in discipline

· Ability to conduct complex, important work under minimal supervision with wide latitude for independent judgment

· Strong troubleshooting and project management skills

· Experience with and desire for frequent customer interaction

 

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills:

· Knowledge of the TazWorks platforms

· Familiarity with the major vendors' offerings in the background-screening industry

· Bachelor’s degree

· PBSA Advanced Certification
